general_information.Description: SWE201c is for people who are new to software engineering. It's also for those who have already developed software, but wish to gain a deeper understanding of the underlying context and theory of software development practices. At the end of this course, we expect learners to be able to: 1.) Build high-quality and secure software using SDLC methodologies such as agile, lean, and traditional/waterfall. 2.) Analyze a software development team's SDLC methodology and make recommendations for improvements. 3.) Compare and contrast software development methodologies with respect to environmental, organizational, and product constraints.
general_information.StudentTasks: Student must get the certification of Software Development Lifecycle specialization from Coursera to be accepted to the final examination
general_information.Note: 1. Complete the online course to be allowed to take Final Exam 2. Final Exam is included of Final Theory Exam (TE) & Final Practical Exam (PE): 100% 3. Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded. 4. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score >=4 & Final PE Score >=4 & FR >= 5 FR = min[10, (Final TE Score * weight of Final TE) + (Final PE Score * weight of Final PE) + bonus]
